resources.string: Unsupported profile version. Recreate the deployment profile using schema version 2.
Pause collection while device is locked

When enabled, all measurement streams pause while the Android lock screen is active, including a swipe-only lock screen. This checks the current lock state, not whether a PIN or password is configured. Collection resumes after unlocking if other collection conditions allow it. This is independent of screen-off collection: either restriction can pause collection. The session and its timer continue; timed sessions can finish while paused. Already buffered measurements can still be stored and uploaded. Paused time creates a gap and is excluded from interval baselines. This setting does not change Performance State. Android may delay background execution. Off by default; applies immediately after saving.
